senses.gloss:
ATTIC (adj.): *एथिनीयः (या, यं); यवनः (नी, नं)
(with less precision).

ATTIRE (v. t.):
(1) वस्ते (वस्, c. 2.) (=to put
on, dress: q. v.);
(2) भूषयति (=to adorn:
q. v.).

ATTIRE (subs.):
(1) वेशः;
(2) परिबर्हः, in rich a.
स्फीतपरिबर्हः (र्हा, र्हं), D. ii.: v. Dress, closses.

ATTITUDE: v. Posture, position. Ph.
Russia
has assumed a threatening a. towards Persia
*पारस्यराज्यं प्रति रुसियैर्विरुद्धवृत्तिः कक्षीकृता।
